similarityReview: The building is reconstructed as a solid 3D mass with a central core and symmetrical side wings. The balcony structures and white frame elements are modeled as protruding boxes to ensure depth. The roof frame is represented by a box structure. All windows and balcony glass are assigned the glassHex color. The rear and side facades are mirrored to ensure a complete 360-degree structure.
